args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Investigated**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate following the latest deploy.
2. **Rolled back**: All production regions were rolled back to **v2.3.0**, the most recent version previously healthy in production.
3. **Verified**: Post-rollback, checkout-api is healthy in all regions with a 0.2% error rate.
4. **Opened incident**: SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy" — describing the degradation and remediation. The on-call engineer has been paged.

Recommended follow-up: root-cause the v2.3.1 health check failures before any re-deployment attempt.
